description: The figure displays two side-by-side horizontal bar charts illustrating the inference time in minutes for different methods, with the left chart titled "Marco-o1-7B" and the right chart featuring a greyed-out title area. In both charts, the vertical axis serves as the category axis, displaying a single group of five colored bars, and is labeled "Inference Time (minute)" with vertically oriented text. The horizontal axes represent the numerical values on a linear scale; the left chart's horizontal axis ranges from 0 to 2.5 with tick marks at intervals of 0.5, while the right chart's horizontal axis ranges from 0 to 7 with tick marks at intervals of 1. The categories are identified by a legend located below each chart, which maps colors to specific methods: Baseline (light green), Fast-Solving Prompt (yellow), SFT (grey), DPO (orange), and O1-Pruner (blue). The bars are arranged from top to bottom in the order they appear in the legend from left to right. In the left chart, the longest bar is the light green Baseline at approximately 2.15, followed by the yellow Fast-Solving Prompt and grey SFT bars at roughly 2.1, the orange DPO bar at about 1.45, and the shortest blue O1-Pruner bar at approximately 1.1. In the right chart, the longest bar is the light green Baseline at approximately 6.1, followed by the grey SFT bar at 5.9, the orange DPO bar at 5.6, the yellow Fast-Solving Prompt bar at 5.0, and the shortest blue O1-Pruner bar at 4.0. The bars are ordered consistently by category rather than by length, and no individual bars are visually emphasized with outlines or annotations.
